PDN interoperability fixtures
============================
Untitled2.pdn, oldPDN3510.pdn and FlattenBlendTest.pdn:
Source: https://github.com/addisonElliott/pypdn/tree/3481b08b3579daf8ab50ecbd03f14619b9c76c8c/tests/data
Author: Addison Elliott. License: MIT; see PYpdn-LICENSE.txt.
Files are unmodified upstream interoperability inputs.
Native5112Resaved.pdn is a Windows application re-save of Untitled2.pdn,
created on 2026-10-24. The original fixture's license applies.
These binary inputs test the PDN interchange format; they are not application artwork.

RustNativeResaved.pdn: Untitled2.pdn decoded/encoded by this Rust codec, then
opened and re-saved by the Windows GUI on 2026-10-25. Same upstream MIT license.

RustAllBlendsResaved.pdn: FlattenBlendTest.pdn decoded/encoded by this Rust codec,
then opened and re-saved by the Windows GUI on 2026-10-25. Same upstream MIT license.
